_note: Battle identity v0 (docs/battle/BATTLE_INTELLIGENCE.md; the master battle-intelligence handoff §2-§4). Every rule and word lives here; trainers/identity.py and its browser copy (app/web/37_identity.html) only evaluate them, and app/test_identity_parity.mjs holds the two together. Nothing here is a new threshold: each bar names the calibrated team-role bar it reuses (trainers/team_roles.json → roles), or is a Gen IV mechanic. Where a function has no calibrated bar or reference pool yet, it is shown as pending and never names a build. Status: provisional (D-082, A-119 to A-124), for Zack to react to.

lens.name: League lens
lens.says: one-on-one at level 100 against every Elite Four and Champion Pokémon of its generation (team_roles.json → pools), our best plan against their game AI, dry field, from full HP
lens._note: The same fights the team roles read (TeamRoles.read → lens). Damage is the calculator's roll range in % of the target's HP at no boosts, from full; Speed is with items, before anything happens (battle/evaluate.py Matchup). Scenario numbers (rain, Trick Room, a boosted priority hit, a low-HP window) are worked out from these rows and are labelled estimates: a stage or weather multiplier on the dry roll, the same estimate the Sweeper's setup boost uses.

bars._note: Each bar reads its value from team_roles.json at run time; the names here only say which one.

categories._note: Move categories (trainers/roles.json → move_categories) and what identity treats them as. A move with a dedicated job is accounted for by that job, not as a plain attack: U-turn is the Pivot's, Rapid Spin the Spinner's, Pursuit the trap's. A self-KO move is an attack once: it counts as one, but the reach numbers leave it out (it can't be repeated).

self_side_removal._note: Moves that clear hazards from the user's own side. Gen IV Defog clears the target's side only (it is not removal for this team); the modern self-side Defog is Gen VI.

spread._note: How a set is built, read from its nature and EVs (a mechanic, not a measure). 252 is one full stat's worth of EVs. A set with no EVs recorded has no spread to account for (blank is no evidence, B19).

weather._note: Gen IV: a weather move lasts five turns counting the one it goes up on (eight with its rock); a weather ability's weather lasts until another replaces it. Only weather the set makes for itself counts.

room._note: Gen IV Trick Room: -7 priority, five turns counting the one it goes up on, so four turns of reversed order after it. It reverses Speed within a priority bracket only: priority still goes first.

pinch._note: Gen III-IV: a pinch ability raises its type's moves 1.5x at a third of its HP or less; a pinch berry gives +1 at a quarter or less. Substitute costs a quarter of max HP, so three from full leave it at 25%.

hp_power._note: Power is 150 x current HP / max HP (at least 1): damage falls with HP.

stealth_rock._note: Stealth Rock takes 1/8 of max HP times the Rock type's effectiveness on entry (Gen IV).

functions._note: The fourteen functions of the handoff (§3), each tracked in three tiers: mechanically plausible (the set can do it), benchmark supported (the League lens shows it does), observed (6v6; nothing recorded yet). 'pending' means the evaluator exists but the bar or reference pool it needs doesn't yet: it never names a build. Attacker is the offensive fallback head, not one of the fourteen.

pending.wallbreaker: needs a defensive reference pool (the walls it has to break, with their recovery): not built yet
pending.cleaner: needs a late-game scenario (the League's Pokémon already weakened): not built yet
pending.revenge_killer: needs a pool of the dangerous attackers it must answer on entry: not built yet
pending.disruptor: needs a bar for how many League Pokémon its disruption has to matter against (the count is shown)
pending.trapper: the League lens fights one-on-one with no switching, so trapping and Pursuit can't be measured there: needs 6v6 evidence
pending.stallbreaker: needs a stall reference pool: not built yet
pending.setup_enabler: a team relationship: read in a team, not on its own

functions.observed: no 6v6 runs recorded for this build yet

heads.says: After one use of its setup move it takes the League down: it moves first against {sweep_first}% and its repeatable attacks 2HKO {sweep_ko2}% (OHKO {sweep_ko1}%), or it lasts instead (three hits from {bulk_take3}% of the 100 hardest attacks), or its priority does the job.
Moves first against {sweep_first}% of the League, and its repeatable attacks 2HKO {sweep_ko2}% and OHKO {sweep_ko1}% of it, no setup.
Breaks the walls in front of it. Pending: there's no defensive reference pool to measure it against yet, so it names nothing.
The Tank role: takes three hits from {bulk_take3}% of the 100 hardest League attacks and 2HKOs {attack_ko2}% of the League back.
The Wall role: takes four hits from {wall_take4}% of one side's 50 hardest attacks, and heals. The side names it (Physical, Special; Mixed for both).
Carries U-turn or Baton Pass and lasts to use it: two hits from {lasts_take2}% of the 100 hardest attacks, or first against {pivot_first}%.
Two or more field jobs it invests in (hazards, its own side's removal, screens, weather by move or rock, Trick Room), and it lasts to do them.
Rapid Spin, and it lasts to use it (two hits from {lasts_take2}% of the hardest attacks, or first against {lasts_first}%). Gen IV Defog doesn't count: it clears the other side.
Stealth Rock, Spikes or Toxic Spikes, and it lasts to set them.
Reflect or Light Screen, and it lasts to set them.
Sets weather with a move or holds the weather's rock, and lasts to do it.
Trick Room, and it lasts to set it.
The Support role, with team healing (Heal Bell, Aromatherapy, Wish).
The Support role: two or more support moves, and it lasts to use them.
Its repeatable attacks 2HKO {attack_ko2}% of the League from full, no boosts (the Tank's bar).

fallback.says: Nothing it does clears a function's bar in the League lens yet, so this names how it's built, not a role.

modifiers.says: It sets its own rain and it pays (Swift Swim, or Water moves 1.5x), and the head's bars hold in the rain: an estimate on the dry roll.
It sets its own sun and it pays (Chlorophyll, or Fire moves 1.5x), and the head's bars hold in the sun: an estimate on the dry roll.
Sets its own Trick Room and, under it, moves first against {sweep_first}% of the League.
Moves first against {sweep_first}% of the League, no boosts (a tie isn't first).
Built to take hits rather than to KO: a defensive spread and a way to heal, and short of the attacker bar.
Takes three hits from {bulk_take3}% of the 100 hardest League attacks.
Takes four hits from {wall_take4}% of the 50 hardest special League attacks, and heals.
Takes four hits from {wall_take4}% of the 50 hardest physical League attacks, and heals.
Pursuit, or a trapping move or ability. Pending: the League lens has nothing that switches, so it needs 6v6 evidence.
Sets a hazard, and lasts to do it.
Explosion or Selfdestruct OHKOs {attack_ko2}% of the League from full: once.
Holds a Choice Band: the lock is part of what it is.
Holds Choice Specs: the lock is part of what it is.
Holds a Choice Scarf: the lock is part of what it is.
Its priority move alone clears the head's KO bar: {attack_ko2}% from full, or {sweep_ko2}% after its setup for a Setup Sweeper.
A pinch ability with Substitute or a pinch berry. Pending: the low-HP window isn't a measured scenario yet.

ranking._note: Lexicographic, never a weighted score (handoff §4.2). 1 centrality: how many of the set's commitments (its four moves, its item, its spread) the name accounts for. 2 discriminative: the head's specificity, then the most specific modifier's, then how many modifiers aren't generic (Physical/Special/Offensive/Defensive are generic). 3 adequacy: how many of the set's conditions (rain, Trick Room, a low-HP window) the name states. 4 naturalness: fewer words. 5 stable: the head's place in 'heads', then the modifiers', then the name's letters.

natures._note: [raised, lowered] for each nature (Gen III+); neutral natures raise and lower nothing.

gates._note: Hard gates on a name, before any ranking (handoff §4.2), in this order: every element earned in the League lens (a pending one makes it a near miss, never a headline); the head accounts for at least one of the set's commitments itself (a function it doesn't invest in isn't its job); every speed or posture word (Fast, Offensive, Defensive, Bulky, Specially Defensive...) adds a commitment the rest of the name doesn't (a generic word has to earn its place; a method or condition word names a mechanism the set carries, which is information in itself, and Physical/Special say which side); no more than max_words words. Weather from an ability the species can't swap is a fact about it, not an investment: it doesn't make a Weather Setter or count toward a Field Controller.
